question_patterns_used.name: Classification
question_patterns_used.lesson_response: Separates quantities from units and base items from non-base distractors.

question_patterns_used.name: Property identification
question_patterns_used.lesson_response: Requires exact unit symbols, prefix multipliers and case-sensitive notation.

question_patterns_used.name: Equation derivation
question_patterns_used.lesson_response: Use supplied unit identities and rearranged supplied models to derive base-unit forms, without teaching later-topic mechanisms.

question_patterns_used.name: Direct calculation
question_patterns_used.lesson_response: Show one factor or power change per line, then verify with an equivalent fraction or reciprocal route.

question_patterns_used.name: Quantitative Calculation & Multi-Step Derivation
question_patterns_used.lesson_response: Provide distinct routes for named-unit expansion, denominator powers, and an unfamiliar-constant unit.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped first part that asks for two SI base units beyond a supplied set.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Exclude supplied units, then retrieve two other valid base units.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Confusing a base unit with a derived unit.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped question gives three base quantities and asks for the remaining ones.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Recognise base quantities, not only their symbols.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Identify which names are quantities and recall omitted quantity names.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Writing unit names where quantity names are requested.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped question mixes SI base units, a quantity, and derived units.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Test each item as a unit and then as an SI base unit.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Selecting current because it is a base quantity, although the prompt asks for units.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped table asks which named quantities are SI base quantities.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Distinguish base quantities from energy and force.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Classify each named quantity before ticking rows.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Assuming every familiar physics quantity is a base quantity.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped direct recall question with kilogram, metre and second already given.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Retrieve other exact SI base-unit names.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Recall the complete set, then select two omitted units.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Giving a derived unit such as newton or joule.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped list contains base units alongside degree Celsius and newton.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Identify every SI base unit in a mixed list.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Check both unit identity and SI base status for each item.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Treating degree Celsius as the SI base unit for temperature.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped question identifies a non-base quantity among four familiar names.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Reject charge while retaining current, length and time.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Compare the four names against the base-quantity list.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Treating charge as a base quantity because it is fundamental in electrical contexts.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped direct request for SI base units other than kilogram, metre and second.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Recall a complete set accurately enough to select valid omissions.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Retrieve all five required pairs, then choose two units not supplied.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Omitting case-sensitive symbols when a later question requests symbols.

questions_visited.why_selected: Checks the required SI-unit and prefix bridge before derived-unit work.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Convert milliseconds to seconds and identify time.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Replace milli with its power-of-ten multiplier, then retain s.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Dropping the unit or treating the prefix as a separate quantity.

questions_visited.why_selected: Directly assesses the base-unit form of force.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Recognise kg m s^-2 as the force unit.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Mixing force with speed or energy units.
lesson_sections_informed: Read named units as short forms
Worked example 1: express a joule in base units

questions_visited.why_selected: Tests the negative power created by a cubic denominator.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Express kilograms per cubic metre in compact base-unit form.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Keep volume in a fraction, then write the denominator as m^-3.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Writing kg m^3 instead of kg m^-3.

questions_visited.why_selected: Requires rearrangement and collection of mixed powers.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Find a constant's base-unit form from a supplied relationship.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Isolate k, substitute F, A, and v units, then subtract denominator powers.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Failing to multiply the area and speed units before dividing.
lesson_sections_informed: Find the unit of an unfamiliar quantity

questions_visited.why_selected: Links force, energy, and power through progressive expansion.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Derive joule and watt base-unit forms.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Expand N in J, then divide J by s for W.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Leaving N or J unexpanded when a base-unit answer is required.
lesson_sections_informed: Worked example 1: express a joule in base units
Worked example 2: express a watt in base units

questions_visited.why_selected: Adds the charge bridge and reciprocal of force to a multi-base calculation.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Use A s for charge, rearrange, and simplify a constant's unit.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Replace C with A s and N with kg m s^-2 before collecting powers.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Missing the reversal of signs when taking a reciprocal.

questions_visited.archetype: mixed prefix conversion and base-unit application
questions_visited.why_selected: Combines previous prefix knowledge with W-to-base-unit expansion.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Convert source data, report power, then express W in base units.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Convert kJ and min first, calculate in W, then expand W.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Using prefixed units inconsistently or omitting the final base-unit form.
